turns.content: Let X be the number of heads in 50 independent tosses of an unspecified coin. Identify the distribution of X.
Write the binomial probability expression and simplify its probability factors.
Compute the two integers C(50,25) and 2^50 used in the exact ratio.
Evaluate P(X=25) as an exact ratio, decimal, and percentage.
Use the exact adjacent-mass ratio to derive P(X=24) from P(X=25), then compare the two probabilities.
Check the ordering against the symmetry and mode of a Binomial(50,1/2) distribution.
Report P(X=25), P(X=24), and their ordering.
